articles.title: Securitize pushes into $6 trillion asset-backed finance market with River One acquisition
articles.snippet: The tokenization firm unveiled an acquisition and a $50 million stock buyback as quarterly revenue rose 13%. SECZ shares jumped 10% after hours.

articles.title: Robinhood backs tokenization of its stock on OKX–ICE platform even as most companies opt out
articles.snippet: The brokerage firm said it would rather help build tokenized markets than sit on the sidelines, following a wave of early corporate pushback to the Intercontinental Exchange and OKX joint venture.

articles.title: A Bitcoin block just neared a 2015 transaction record, but paid only $180 in fees
articles.snippet: The AntPool block came within 984 transactions of Bitcoin’s 2015 record, even as fees made up less than 0.1% of the miner’s payout.

articles.title: Google’s AI chip push adds more pressure on Nvidia
articles.snippet: Google’s specialised AI chips threaten greater competition as Nvidia faces a leadership investigation.

articles.title: North Korean hackers are creating memecoins to wash loot from $6.3 billion Binance hack
articles.snippet: North Korean hackers used six homemade memecoins to launder 117,000 NEAR, worth about $430,000, from the $6.3 billion Binance hack, Elliptic says.
